justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/description/modifier/package-info.java, ModifierContributor.java, Visibility.java, and the other 15 production classes in the package. The package is a cohesive, flat modifier model: 17 main files totaling 1,832 LOC, mostly small 78-140 line enums for specific modifier kinds (visibility, field/method/type manifestation, openness, transitivity, etc.), plus one 291-line interface/resolver. The package-info explicitly describes it as a package for high-level, type-safe Java modifiers, and there is no evidence of unrelated responsibilities or excessive breadth that would indicate a God Component.
